mapper.update: UPDATE mac_user SET user_points = user_points - #{points} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_points >= #{points}
UPDATE mac_user SET user_points = user_points + #{points} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE mac_user SET user_points = #{points} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE mac_card SET card_use_status = 1, card_sale_status = 1, user_id = #{userId}, card_use_time = #{useTime} WHERE card_id = #{cardId} AND card_use_status = 0

UPDATE mac_card SET card_use_status = 0, card_sale_status = #{saleStatus}, user_id = 0, card_use_time = 0 WHERE card_id = #{cardId} AND card_use_status = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} AND card_use_time = #{useTime}
UPDATE mac_vod SET vod_hits = vod_hits + 1 WHERE vod_id = #{vodId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_plog (user_id, plog_type, plog_points, plog_time, plog_remarks) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{points}, #{time}, #{remarks})

INSERT INTO mac_ulog (user_id, ulog_mid, ulog_type, ulog_rid, ulog_sid, ulog_nid, ulog_points, ulog_time) SELECT #{userId}, #{mid}, #{type}, #{rid}, 0, 0, 0, #{time} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mac_ulog WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ulog_mid = #{mid} AND ulog_type = #{type} AND ulog_rid = #{rid})
INSERT INTO mac_gbook (gbook_name, gbook_content, gbook_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{content}, #{time})
